title: Implement SqliteAgentSessionStore for durable agent session persistence
description:
AgentSessionService currently uses InMemoryAgentSessionStore which loses all sessions on server restart. When AgentSession:PersistSessions=true is configured, the startup guard in AgentSessionService throws InvalidOperationException. This task implements SqliteAgentSessionStore.

### Requirements
- Implement IAgentSessionStore with SQLite backing in the existing SqliteMemorySmithDatabase pattern
- Schema: agent_sessions table with all AgentSession fields, history stored as JSON column
- Register conditionally: if PersistSessions=true, register SqliteAgentSessionStore; otherwise InMemoryAgentSessionStore
- Remove the startup guard in AgentSessionService constructor once the SQLite store is implemented
- Handle AgentSession.History deserialization (private List<ChatMessage> field — needs [JsonInclude] or custom converter)
- Add migration for the new table (follow existing migration pattern in SqliteMemorySmithDatabase)

### Note on AgentSession._history serialization
The backing List<ChatMessage> is private and will not serialize via System.Text.Json defaults. Options:
1. Add a `[JsonInclude]` annotated property
2. Add a custom JsonConverter<AgentSession>
3. Store history as a separate JSON column (list of {role, content} objects)

### Acceptance criteria
- Sessions survive server restart when PersistSessions=true
- SqliteAgentSessionStore passes all tests in AgentSessionTests.cs (IAgentSessionStore tests)
- In-memory store remains the default
